name: pinned-cli-reference-in-test-fixtures
description: When a repo cuts over from a reference CLI to its own reimplementation but must keep proving compat, pin the reference as a test FIXTURE instead of relying on PATH: a wrapper script + package.json/bun.lock in tests/fixtures/<ref>/ running the exact pinned version under its runtime, an env override (SEEDS_COMPAT_SD) for alternates, a --version assert to catch stale provisioning, and skip-with-note (stderr) when unprovisioned so plain CI stays green. Document provisioning (bun install) in the fixture README. Applied in crates/seeds/tests/fixtures/sd-reference for sd 0.5.15 (seed seeds-3791).
